changelog:
Added:
- Playlists: the multi-panel viewer can now save and reload its setup. Name and save the current queue, load one back (replacing or appending), overwrite, rename and delete. Your panel layout and playback mode are saved with it, and a rolling "Last session" autosave means a reload no longer throws away hours of curation. The page is now "Playlists / Multi panel".
- Per-panel playlists: a playback mode where every panel runs its own independent playlist. Load a different one into each of your up to 6 panels, shuffle any panel on its own, and swap or clear one without touching the rest. Saving in this mode stores the whole arrangement, so a single playlist brings your entire rig back.
- Multi-panel: device sync per panel. Funscripts now work in the multi-panel viewer, and each panel has its own Sync button to claim the connected device.
- Multi-panel: drag and drop the queue thumbnails to reorder playback, and the queue strip now expands on hover so it stays out of the way while you watch.
- Copy to gallery: copy a file's reference into a mix gallery without moving anything on disk, so the same file can sit in several playlists at once.
- Tag inputs now autocomplete, suggesting existing tags as you type and flagging when you're about to create a brand-new one, so a typo no longer silently forks your tag list.
- Gallery view: apply tags to every selected file at once, plus Shift+click range selection in Photos and Videos.
- Device Control: an Auto-sync toggle so funscripted videos take over the device without pressing Sync every time.
- Intiface: support for rotating toys (Kiiroo Onyx/Titan, Vorze, We-Vibe Nova) and oscillating toys (Fun Factory Stronic).
- Loading Bay: choose whether a sorted video's funscript moves with it or goes to your central funscript library.
- Tag Manager: browse the full WD14/JoyTag vocabulary and pick exactly which tags AI tagging is allowed to apply.

Changed:
- The video player's funscript heatmap now spans the full width of the seek bar, so its peaks line up with the moment they actually occur.
- Tag Manager now fully respects your chosen theme accent instead of hardcoding violet.

Fixed:
- The Handy: funscripted videos now stroke the way the script was authored. Scripts were being resampled down to 10 positions a second, turning anything fast into coarse lunges and jitter. Playback also starts in step now, and the device no longer runs away on a paused video or keeps stroking after you hit pause.
- Photos/Videos right-click "Move to gallery" did nothing; it now opens the gallery picker and moves the files.
